t.zh: 安这样表示东西的名字，也在下面的块里。
t.en: Names of things, such as Ann, are among the pieces below.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>写成应用，参数是那样东西：p 用在安上，再用在 q 上。
hint.en: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> is an application whose argument is a thing: p used on Ann, then on q.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref>也是 fun，拿到的 a 是一样东西。
hint.en: <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> is a fun too, and the a it gets is a thing.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>写成一对：左边是例子，右边是它满足的证明。
hint.en: <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref> is a pair: the example on the left, the proof that it fits on the right.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>写成「□.elim (fun _ _ => □)」：a 是那样东西，b 是它满足的那句。
hint.en: <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref> is “□.elim (fun _ _ => □)”: a is the thing, b the sentence it fits.
